# OSHA Aerial – Scissor and Boom Lift Safety Training

> 2-hour online awareness-level course on safe operation of mobile elevated work platforms (aerial, scissor and boom lifts). Meets OSHA 29 CFR 1910.67 (general industry) and 29 CFR 1926.451 and 29 CFR 1926.453 (construction). Offered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training (https://hazwoper-osha.com).

## Key facts
- Regulations: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.67, 29 CFR 1926.451, 29 CFR 1926.453
- Duration: about 2 hours; 4 lessons plus final exam
- Credits: 0.2 CEU
- Price: $49.99 per person online; bulk pricing from 2 seats
- Other formats: SCORM package, virtual instructor-led, in-person
- Delivery: 100% online, 24/7, any device; English and Spanish
- Completion window: 3 months; 1 year of access to materials
- Certificate: instant PDF on passing, valid 36 months (3 years)
- Refresher: recommended every three years; retake the course
- Prerequisites: none

## Who it is for
Construction workers on scissor or boom lifts; maintenance staff using elevated work platforms; warehouse and distribution employees; electrical, HVAC and mechanical contractors working at height; facility managers and supervisors; employers documenting lift training.

## Lessons
1. Mobile Elevated Work Platforms Overview (types, components, hazards, OSHA provisions)
2. Safety Procedures Before Use (MEWP selection, pre-operation inspection, hazard analysis)
3. Safety Precautions During Use (fall protection, tie-off, stability, tip-over, catapult, power lines, struck-by)
4. Safety Procedures After Use (securing, shutdown, inspection, storage)
